_role_rankings.description: Ranked lists of working, non-rate-limited free models only. Best model first. Providers in _provider_usage for the current month are automatically excluded. Removed, paid, broken, and rate-limited models must not appear here.

_provider_usage.description: Tracks providers that are fully consumed (rate-limited or out of quota) for a given month. Providers listed here are excluded from _role_rankings for that month. Format: provider_id â†’ { month: 'YYYY-MM', reason: string }.

_known_issues.description: Non-fatal issues that affect usability but don't prevent the model from working.

issues.issue: HuggingFace Router free tier has very low rate limits — a few requests per day for unauthenticated users, slightly more with a token. All HF Router models hit 429s quickly in practice.
issues.impact: All HuggingFace Router models are rate-limited in practice, even though they technically work.
issues.workthrough: Authenticate with a HF token for marginally higher limits, or use models through other providers (e.g. the same models on OpenRouter).

issues.issue: Returns extra fields in assistant messages: reasoning, reasoning_details
issues.impact: Causes schema validation errors in strict OpenAI-compatible clients that reject unknown properties
issues.workaround: Use through OpenRouter opencode gateway, or configure client to ignore/strip unknown fields

issues.workaround: Monitor status; migrate to alternative if removed

_validation_method.description: How free model statuses were determined.
_validation_method.procedure: Direct API calls per provider. Cerebras models re-tested 2026-05-27 after deprecation date â€” all three still functional.

key_findings.burst_vs_persistent: Most free models that 429 on first request also 429 on every subsequent request, even with 5s delays. This indicates persistent rate limiting, not just burst protection.
key_findings.single_call_insufficient: A single successful API call does NOT mean a model is not rate limited. Several models succeed once but fail on every subsequent request.
key_findings.model_id_format: OpenRouter API calls should NOT use the 'openrouter/' prefix. Use 'provider/model:free' format.
key_findings.gemini_4_26b: 0/6 requests succeeded â€” persistently rate limited.
key_findings.gemini_4_31b: 1/6 requests succeeded (3rd delayed attempt) â€” effectively rate limited, not reliably usable.
key_findings.parallel_load: Running all models in parallel via Start-Job causes intermittent 429s even on reliable models. Sequential testing recommended for final validation.
